Definition
[Lamination] 1. Definition 8.5.2\group laminationsSource: thurston:page-0200, thurston:page-0201 A lamination is a closed subset locally modeled on $\R ^{n-k}\times B$ with coordinate changes preserving the transverse $B$-coordinate. Its leaves are the connected leafwise pieces; a geodesic lamination has geodesic leaves.
